headline: Continued public hearing on Lowell alcoholic beverages regulations, plus special licenses and applications for Hive Public Market, Mill No. 5, and Tescobar.
summary: The meeting covers a continued public hearing on alcoholic beverages regulations. It also covers special licenses, a special event permit, a common victualler license, a Class 2 dealer license, a request to continue a hearing, and complaints about three licensed businesses.
items: Continuation of the public hearing on Lowell alcoholic beverages regulations.
Applications by Rachel Chandler for two special one-day licenses to sell wines and malt beverages only at Hive Public Market, 101 Paige Street, on four dates.
Application by Ashleigh Mutty for two special one-day licenses for Lowell Community Charter Public School events at Mill No. 5, 250 Jackson Street.
Application by Ernest Lugo for a special event permit to include 18 to 20 year-old persons at 72 Middlesex Street on November 18, 2026.
Application by Claudia Carreiro, Corner Crust & Crumb Inc., for a common victualler license at 165 Chelmsford Street.
Application by Angel Ramos, sole proprietor, Angels Auto Care, for a Class 2 dealer license at 45 Meadowcroft Street, Unit 1.
Request to continue the public hearing for HLE TargetCO LLC d/b/a Showcase Cinema Lowell's transfer of its all alcoholic beverages restaurant license at 31 Reiss Ave to the November 19, 2026 meeting.
Complaint regarding Lowell Exchange Inc. d/b/a Lowell Pawn, premises at 755 Lakeview Avenue.
Complaint regarding Sokha Pawn Brokers d/b/a Prasat Meas Jewelry & Pawn, premises at 28 Branch Street.
Complaint regarding Club Passe-Temps of Lowell, Mass., licensed on-premises club, premises at 369-371 Moody Street.
location: City Council Chambers, City Hall, 375 Merrimack St., Lowell, MA 01852
plain_text:
*November 3, 2026
In compliance with Massachusetts General Law chapter 30A, sections 18 –25, notice is hereby given that a meeting of the License Commission of the City of Lowell is scheduled to take place on Thursday, 
November 5, 2026, at 6:00 PM. Members of the public may attend in-person in the City Council Chambers, City Hall, 375 Merrimack St., Lowell, MA 01852.*
Acceptance Of The Meeting Minutes For September 17, 2026.
01. 20260917 LICENSE COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT_02 MINUTES.PDF
Acceptance Of The Meeting Minutes For October 15, 2026.
02. 20261015 LICENSE COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT_02 MINUTES.PDF
Applications By Rachel Chandler, For Two "Special One-Day Licenses To Sell/Dispense Wines And Malt Beverages Only" At Hive Public Market, 101 Paige Street:
• "Film & Honk Band" on Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 3 to 10 PM.
• "Sip & Shop" on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 11 AM to 9 PM.
• "Sip & Shop" on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 AM to 9 PM.
• "Sip & Shop" on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 11 AM to 7 PM.
Application By Ashleigh Mutty, Manager Of Free Spirits Events Company, For Two "Special One Day License To Sell/Dispense Wines And Malt Beverages Only," For The Lowell Community Charter 
Public School Events At Mill No. 5, 250 Jackson Street:
• "Staff Holiday Party" on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 4 to 8 PM.
• "Learners to Leaders" on Thursday, April 15, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM.
Application By Ernest Lugo, License Manager Of Tescobar Performance Center, For "Special Event Permit" To Invite And Include 18 To 20 Year-Old Persons To The Alcohol-Licensed Establishment At 
72 Middlesex Street. Event To Take Place On Wednesday, November 18, 2026, From 5:30 To 8:30 PM.
Application By Claudia Carreiro, Corner Crust & Crumb Inc. For Common Victualler License For Premises At 165 Chelmsford Street.
Application By Angel Ramos, Sole Proprietor, Angels Auto Care, For Class 2 Dealer License For Premises At 45 Meadowcroft Street, Unit 1.
Continuation Of The Public Hearing To Discuss Lowell Alcoholic Beverages Regulations.
08. CONTINUATION OF PUBLIC HEARING ON REGULATIONS.PDF
Request To Continue Public Hearing For An Application By HLE TargetCO LLC [D/B/A] Showcase Cinema Lowell, To Transfer Of The "All Alcoholic Beverages" Restaurant License For 31 Reiss Ave At 
The November 19, 2026, License Commission Meeting.
Complaint Regarding Lowell Exchange Inc. D/B/A Lowell Pawn, Premises At 755 Lakeview Avenue.
Complaint Regarding Sokha Pawn Brokers D/B/A Prasat Meas Jewelry & Pawn, Premises At 28 Branch Street.
Complaint Regarding Club Passe-Temps Of Lowell, Mass., Licensed On-Premises Club, Premises At 369 -371 Moody Street.
Adjournment.
Applications are due by Noon, November 13, 2026, for the next License Commission meeting, which will be held on November 19, 2026. Applications for annual alcohol license transactions should be 
submitted earlier to guarantee board review.
